basic_info.description: True blue in the Portola! Once inside, you're greeted with the open living room, dining area and kitchen, perfect for a full household and gatherings. Upstairs has two generous bedrooms, an updated full bathroom with skylight (imagine taking a soak in a sun-filled or moon-filled sanctuary!) and powder room. Downstairs suite has it's own kitchen and bath, yard access and garage access. Step outside into your garden retreat: a perfect mixture of hardscape and lush garden, including an avocado tree, tomato plants, and a variety of other flowers and plants. All of this steps away from McLaren Park. Restaurants, coffee, banks, markets, and other shops are close by on San Bruno Ave., plus quick freeway and public transportation makes downtown and the rest of the Bay Area quick and easy!   The Portola is ideal for those who love the Sunset and Richmond districts of SF, providing distinctive SF homes, proximity to shopping, restaurants and markets, transportation and a distinct neighborhood feel.
